catalogue_requests.reason: cap.motion.joint_position.v1 is in radians, requires a reached output and carries an R1 floor. This command sends mspeed and MoveJ. Joint numbers are degrees on a rotary axis and millimetres on a linear axis (tcp_driver.py:486-488). Class_command.gpl:280 sets the default reply to 0. tcp_driver.py:23 says a leading 0 means success. That token is not a reached flag. The package risk is R2.
catalogue_requests.summary: Send mspeed, then MoveJ, for robot 1. A leading 0 is the client's success code (tcp_driver.py:23), not proof the arm reached the target.

catalogue_requests.reason: cap.motion.stop.v1 does not state this controller's status-port halt. The robot port does not answer another command while a motion handler is running (Main.gpl:203-209), so halt is sent on the status port (Cmd.gpl:1840) after selectRobot 1. Cmd.gpl:1840-1842 is RapidDecel and does not clear the mailbox. The mailbox is cleared after Handler returns (Main.gpl:606). The stop fails while a MoveJ reply is outstanding. A complete reply is sent after the mailbox wait (Main.gpl:225) and clears the fence, and a later halt reads TrajState again. The status port serves one client (Main.gpl:88-90). A busy or unreachable port fails the stop. Power stays on (Cmd.gpl:1836) and this package does not re-enable it.
catalogue_requests.summary: On one status-port connection, select robot 1, halt, and read state until TrajState is 0 or 1. A complete MoveJ reply retires the command; this halt confirms only after that, on a fresh state read.

MODEL REVIEW (grok-4.7, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Round-2 repair after Codex blocked on command retirement and on a shared connect lock.
